meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: Claude 能用 Python 编写 Cirq 量子线路,进行模拟(含噪声)、参数扫描与线路优化,并生成提交到 Google、IonQ 等量子硬件的代码与结果分析。
howto.when: 当你要用 Python 设计/模拟量子线路、做参数扫描或噪声建模,或打算在 Google Quantum AI、IonQ 等量子硬件上运行任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Cirq 写一个贝尔态线路并模拟 1000 次
say.note: 返回 Cirq 代码、线路图和模拟结果的直方图。

say.text: 给这个线路加上退极化噪声再做密度矩阵模拟
say.note: 生成含噪声模拟代码与结果对比。

say.text: 把线路优化到 Google 硬件的门集并准备提交
say.note: 输出优化后线路与硬件提交模板代码。

howto.what_en: Claude will write, simulate, and run Cirq quantum circuits in Python, including parameter sweeps, noise modeling, circuit optimization, and deployment to hardware backends such as Google, IonQ, Azure Quantum, AQT, and Pasqal.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design/simulate quantum circuits in Python, run parameter sweeps or noise modeling, or run tasks on quantum hardware like Google Quantum AI or IonQ.

say_en.text: Write a Bell-state Cirq circuit and simulate it 1000 times.
say_en.note: Returns Cirq code, circuit diagram, and result histogram.

say_en.text: Add depolarizing noise to this circuit and run a density-matrix simulation.
say_en.note: Produces noisy-simulation code and comparison results.

say_en.text: Optimize this circuit for Google hardware gates and prepare a submission.
say_en.note: Outputs optimized circuit and hardware-submission template.
